req.title: Return all players sorted by id
req.statement: The system shall list players in insertion (id) order on GET /players/.
triggers: return all players sorted by id

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-031 requires GET /players/ to return all players sorted by insertion (id) order with HTTP 200. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — verify HTTP 200, all 26 pre-loaded players returned, and IDs are in ascending insertion order matching the known seed order; (2) negative NEG — verify that a malformed URL variant returns 4xx, not 2xx; (3) boundary BVA — verify the first and last player in the sorted list match the exact first and last seeded rows, catching off-by-one index mutations; (4) DT — verify the response body is a JSON array (not object/null) and each element contains the required fields; (5) STC — verify ordering is stable across two consecutive calls (cache HIT path returns same order).

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_all_players_first_and_last_element_match_seed_boundary():
    client = TestClient(app)

    assert last["squadNumber"] == 26
    assert last["firstName"] == "Aditya"
    assert last["lastName"] == "Mehta"
    second_to_last = body[24]

tests.name: test_get_all_players_response_schema_and_field_presence
actions: Inspect each element for required fields
expected: Each element contains id, firstName, lastName, squadNumber, position
No element is missing required fields
squadNumber values are exactly 1 through 26 in order
trace: R-PLAYER-031: response model PlayerResponseModel fields must be present
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_all_players_response_schema_and_field_presence():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/players/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26
    required_fields = {"id", "firstName", "lastName", "squadNumber", "position"}
    for i, player in enumerate(body):
        for field in required_fields:
            assert field in player, f"Missing field {field} at index {i}"
        assert isinstance(player["id"], str)
        assert len(player["id"]) == 36
        assert isinstance(player["squadNumber"], int)
    squad_numbers = [p["squadNumber"] for p in body]
    assert squad_numbers == list(range(1, 27))

tests.name: test_get_all_players_order_stable_across_two_calls_cache_hit
preconditions: Cache may be cold or warm
actions: Send GET /players/ (first call — cache MISS expected)
Send GET /players/ (second call — cache HIT expected)
Compare id order of both responses
expected: ID order is identical between both calls
Second call has X-Cache: HIT header
trace: R-PLAYER-031: order must be stable; cache must not reorder results
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_all_players_order_stable_across_two_calls_cache_hit():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get("/players/")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert len(body1) == 26
    ids1 = [p["id"] for p in body1]
    r2 = client.get("/players/")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert len(body2) == 26
    ids2 = [p["id"] for p in body2]
    assert ids1 == ids2
    assert r2.headers.get("X-Cache") == "HIT"
    assert ids1[0] == "97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802"
    assert ids1[25] == "77a3ac92-52d1-48c4-871c-73988df20dc8"
